title: CoreDependency.lock.json
description: Schema for the pin describing which claude-swap (Python core) revision the macOS app bundles. Validated by scripts/verify-core.sh.

repository.description: HTTPS clone URL of the canonical claude-swap repository. Configurable so forks/mirrors can be used.

tag.description: Git tag pinned for this build, e.g. 'v0.24.0'. Null only before the first real pin has been made.

commitSha.description: Full 40-character commit SHA the tag resolves to, OR the literal placeholder 'PENDING-run-scripts/update-core.sh' before the first pin. Never a branch name.

pythonPackageVersion.description: Value of [project.version] in the pinned core's pyproject.toml.

bridgeProtocolVersion.description: Version of the stdin/stdout JSON bridge protocol implemented by the helper (see contracts/**). Bump when the protocol changes incompatibly; the Swift CoreBridge client checks this against its own expected version at launch.

helperBuildVersion.description: Monotonically increasing build counter for the frozen helper binary, bumped by scripts/update-core.sh every time the pin changes. Independent of pythonPackageVersion (a re-pin at the same package version still bumps this).

binaryName.description: Must match the literal string ClaudeSwap/CoreBridge/BridgeProcess.swift's HelperLocator passes to Bundle.main.url(forAuxiliaryExecutable:).

bundleLocation.description: Where package-release.sh places the built binary inside the .app bundle, informational (derived from binaryName + Contents/MacOS/).

entryPointCandidates.description: Ordered list of Python entry points to try when freezing the helper. First one that resolves in the pinned checkout wins.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp set by scripts/update-core.sh.

updatedBy.description: Free-form identifier (script name / CI actor) that last wrote this file.
